Q1: Which branch should the fix PR target?
Choices:
A. PR #7076's head branch `ai/issue-7072`, where `pr6576-shard-followup.yml` exists. PR #7076's CI then goes green when the fix merges, and the entry reaches `main` with #7076. (RECOMMENDED)
B. The default branch `main`. **Note:** with the workflow missing on `main`, line 79 fails, so the fix would only work if it lands after #7076 merges. Until then it would turn `main` CI red.
C. Don't file a separate fix PR. Close this issue and let PR #7076's own review/autofix loop add the allow-list entry, since the failure is caused by that PR.
